purpose: Falsify the source-confounded v12 clean gate with one dataset that supplies both labels.

selection.policy: lowest source SHA-256 after excluding every locally recorded CIFAKE JSONL identity
selection.train_eval_use: evaluation only; never train, tune, calibrate or threshold on these rows

evaluation.conditions: clean plus the 19 individually applied workshop conditions
evaluation.secondary: 0.5 clean AUC + 0.5 pooled transformed AUC, worst individual condition AUC

clean_interpretation.at_least_0.80: useful within-source evidence, still not broad transfer proof
clean_interpretation.below_0.65: reject the representation as a trusted primary candidate

boundary: The gate contains only low-resolution CIFAKE content and cannot establish performance on broad real photography or unseen generator families.
